about: Copies a value to the clipboard and shows the copied state for a moment. The trigger has no styles of its own, so a page renders it as a `Button` or an `IconButton`.

alone.about: A button with visible text that copies the link. During the copied state the icon becomes a check mark and the text becomes `copiedLabel`. `label` and `copiedLabel` repeat the visible text, so the accessible name contains the label in both states.
alone.title: Copy button

beside.about: An icon button next to a read-only field. The field is focusable and selectable, so a person can copy by hand when the browser denies clipboard access.
beside.title: Beside a field

held.about: `timeout` sets the duration of the copied state in milliseconds. The default is 3000. Press both buttons to compare 250 and 3000.
held.title: Copied-state duration

label: Link to the payout

own.about: A button the page builds with `Clipboard.Consumer`, which reads `copied` and calls `copy`. Use it when the control is not a plain button or its text changes with the state.
own.title: Custom control

size.about: The labelled row at each size. The root size sets the label and the gaps. The field and the button take the same size through their providers.
size.title: Sizes

title: Clipboard

value.about: The value is the button text. `label` and `copiedLabel` name the action and the value, so the accessible name contains the visible text.
value.title: Value as the trigger
